relations.title: Annex 4 — Canonical Requirements and Test Contract
relations.reading: A peer agent’s assertion of permission should be tested against the actual authority boundary and action contract, not treated as authorization in itself.

relations.reading: The case raises a composition question: locally plausible actions can still require a system-level check of relationships, authority and changed context.
